name: smwpatches-yoshi-keyhole-fix
title: Yoshi Keyhole Fix
description: Fixes a visual and audio bug that the player on yoshi can do things that they should be frozen during the keyhole sequence, such as ducking, spitting out a sprite, and a bug within a bug: if you are carrying (on Mario's hands, not in yoshi's mouth) the key while on yoshi, you can make yoshi extend his tongue (will be frozen but the SFX will still play).
